data_fields.name: snap_threshold_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 (glide only when the change is fewer than 4 tiles)

data_fields.name: glide_percent_of_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 by default (glide off); glide = step time x percent / 100

data_fields.name: shake_passes
data_fields.donor_constant: len from the usecode call (2 in one other caller)

best_idea: Keep the world camera still while the hero stays inside a centred dead box, move it one step only when the hero leaves that box, and glide the move without crossing a jump larger than a few tiles.
decision_why: The dead box, look-ahead on the destination tile, snap threshold and stop-settle are the parts a 3D third-person follow camera can keep; the donor is a 2D tile scroll, so pixel offsets and map wrap are rejected.
acceptance: The camera holds still while the hero moves inside the centre box, follows within one step time after the hero leaves it with no overshoot, and snaps for a jump at or above the snap distance; a client test asserts the position is unchanged for moves inside the box and reaches the target within one glide length.
